question: Radhe starts from Point A and drives 32 km towards west. He then takes a left turn, drives 30 km, turns left and drives 49 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 46 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 17 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns unless specified)
solution:
Given:

Radhe starts from Point A and drives 32 km towards west.

Then, he takes a left turn and drives 30 km.

Next, he turns left and drives 49 km, then takes a left turn and drives 46 km.

Finally, he takes a final left turn and drives 17 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7f380b036913bdc946445908750c96694e95ff55c13d2669a45078bbcf043c3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e90b39c47b86078f0b341a6d1d4fb4d0bffae7ceaa7068d30d92322bc7730821.png] 

So, Point P is 16 km North from his starting point A. To reach Point A again, he must drive 16 km to the South.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
